containers.name: mymo
containers.description: MyMo app source files, shared across multiple projects/pipelines, not specific to any single one.

containers.name: ToLAKE
containers.description: Shared FTP drop location used by several projects' datalake pipelines, not exclusive to ndid_data_collection.

containers.name: ndid_customer_journey
containers.description: Gzipped daily file: ndid_customer_journey_<yyyymmdd>.csv.gz, with a companion ndid_customer_journey_<yyyymmdd>.cksum for validation.

columns.name: action_datetime
columns.description: Current datetime of the log

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer ID of customer who did the action, optional in deeplink flow

columns.name: mymo_user_id
columns.description: MyMo user ID, present only after login

columns.name: activity_code
columns.description: Activity code (e.g. NDID_NTL_01, NDID_DL_03), see Business Scenarios docs

columns.name: activity_name
columns.description: Activity name (e.g. NDID_NOTI_LIST_VIEW)

columns.name: details
columns.description: JSON string of extra detail sent by the frontend, e.g. {"popup_code":"xxxx","ndid_status":"xxxx","can_uplift":"xxxx"}. Empty {} when nothing to send.

columns.name: device
columns.description: Device model, from standard vipera header

columns.name: os
columns.description: OS name, from standard vipera header

columns.name: os_version
columns.description: OS version, from standard vipera header

columns.name: mymo_version
columns.description: MyMo app version, from standard vipera header

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session identifier, logged by vipera

columns.name: server_id
columns.description: Server identifier, logged by vipera

columns.name: client_ip
columns.description: Client IP address, logged by vipera

columns.name: action_datetime
columns.description: Current datetime of the log

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer ID of customer who did the action

columns.name: citizen_id

columns.description: NDID application number

columns.description: State sent by ekyc on request: IDP_CREATED, IDP_REJECTED, IDP_TIMEDOUT, IDP_CANCEL, IDP_COMPLETED

columns.name: requestor_node_id

columns.description: Forwarded from MyMo NDID application: requestor node description

columns.description: Forwarded from MyMo NDID application: request timestamp

columns.name: application_creation_time
columns.description: Forwarded from MyMo NDID application: creation time

columns.name: application_request_timeout
columns.description: Forwarded from MyMo NDID application: request timeout

columns.name: application_last_update_datetime
columns.description: Forwarded from MyMo NDID application: last update datetime
